rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [AGENT, IMPORTANT NEWS INCOMING.]
rows.current: Bossu: [特工，重要消息传来。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BIG BRAIN SQUEAKS OVER HERE HAS SOMETHING TO SHARE!]
rows.current: Tomcat: [这边这位大脑袋小吱吱有事要分享！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [I DID IT! I GOT A BREAKTHROUGH!]
rows.current: Mauser: [我做到了！我取得了突破！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [SLOW DOWN, SLOW DOWN. WHAT'S GOING ON?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [慢点，慢点。怎么回事？]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [I MANAGED TO CAL- CULATE WHERE THAT ROGUE AGENT]
rows.current: Mauser: [我成功计算出那个脱控特工——我是说，你的姐姐——所在的位置了！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [-I MEAN, YOUR SISTER, IS LOCATED!]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [WHAT!? REALLY? WHERE IS SHE?]
rows.current: Yiffai: [什么！？ 真的？ 她在哪？]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [YOU SEE, FIRST I NOTED THE AREAS WITHOUT RECEPTION]
rows.current: Mauser: [你看，我先记下了那些没有接收信号的区域，并把它们和各竞技场做了三角定位，在你-]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [AND TRIANGULATED THOSE WITH THE ARENAS WHERE YO-]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [MAUSER, PLEASE!]
rows.current: Yiffai: [毛鼠，拜托！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [R-RIGHT! YOUR SISTER IS LOCATED IN ZERONIA]
rows.current: Mauser: [对、对！你姐姐位于泽罗尼亚]

rows.speaker: Mauser
rows.source: [WHY, JUST TO THE WEST OF WHERE YOU CRASH LANDED!]
rows.current: Mauser: [哎，就在你坠机着陆处的西边！]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [RIGHT WHERE I LANDED... WHY DIDN'T I REALIZE...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [就在我着陆的地方…… 我为什么没意识到……]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [NOW NOW, YOU MAY BE THE PPP'S ACE AGENT]
rows.current: Tomcat: [好啦好啦，你或许是 PPP 的王牌特工，但你可不是气味猎犬。这种事总会发生。]

rows.speaker: Tomcat
rows.source: [BUT YOU'RE NO SCENT HOUND. THESE THINGS HAPPEN.]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [TOMCAT'S RIGHT, YIFFAI. BUT NOW THAT YOU KNOW WHERE]
rows.current: Bossu: [雄猫说得对，伊吠。但既然你现在知道你姐姐在哪，我想你知道该怎么做。]

rows.speaker: Bossu
rows.source: [YOUR SISTER IS, I THINK YOU KNOW WHAT TO DO.]

rows.speaker: Yiffai
rows.source: [YEAH, IT'S TIME TO SEE HOW MUCH I'VE GROWN...]
rows.current: Yiffai: [是啊，是时候看看我成长了多少……]

rows.current: Mauser: [哦！而且导航地图坐标已经发出，所以你应该能轻松到达那里。祝你好运！]

rows.speaker: Mauser
